استشهدتم (form X)
# اِسْتَشْهَدْتُمْ (istašhadtum) /is.taʃ.had.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# اُسْتُشْهِدْتُمْ (ustušhidtum) /us.tuʃ.hid.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
